rt:model.comment: Стандартная подмодель ПОРТАЛа для Dull Screen

rt:param.name: VL_type
rt:param.comment: Тип предвыбора (сколько из скольки). Разрешено: 1о2, 1о3, 2о3 1k2 или 1k3 для VL и ещё 2o2 и 3o3 для IVL

rt:param.name: OneDigit
rt:param.comment: Для предвыбора 1 из 2 или 1 из 3 обрезать индикатор справа и показывать только одну цифру

rt:var.name: MyStrokeWdth
rt:var.comment: Толщина рамок в зависимости от управляемости

rt:var.name: CatNr
rt:var.comment: Надо узнать, это VL (37) или IVL (30)

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub Show_Selection() If Shorter Then If (PRJSPEC.ObjectColorEx(4, Col1, 11) == Color_Sel) Then text_1.font_size = 16 * HeightRatio text_1.font_weight = "bold" text_1.text_decoration = "underline" Else text_1.font_size = 13 * HeightRatio text_1.font_weight = "normal" text_1.text_decoration = "none" End If Else If (PRJSPEC.ObjectColorEx(4, Col1, 11) == Color_Sel) Then text_1.font_size = 16 * HeightRatio text_1.font_weight = "bold" text_1.text_decoration = "underline" text_1.fill = "black" Else text_1.font_size = 12 * HeightRatio text_1.font_weight = "normal" text_1.text_decoration = "none" text_1.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If If (PRJSPEC.ObjectColorEx(4, Col2, 11) == Color_Sel) Then text_2.font_size = 16 * HeightRatio text_2.font_weight = "bold" text_2.text_decoration = "underline" text_2.fill = "black" Else text_2.font_size = 12 * HeightRatio text_2.font_weight = "normal" text_2.text_decoration = "none" text_2.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If If (PRJSPEC.ObjectColorEx(4, Col3, 11) == Color_Sel) Then text_3.font_size = 16 * HeightRatio text_3.font_weight = "bold" text_3.text_decoration = "underline" text_3.fill = "black" Else text_3.font_size = 12 * HeightRatio text_3.font_weight = "normal" text_3.text_decoration = "none" text_3.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If End If End Sub

Sub Get_Selection() If HasErr || Z0 == Nothing Then Backgr.fill = Color_ErLink Exit Sub End If
If Shorter Then Status = PRJSPEC.TPTS_VL_1(KKS, Col1, AStat) If (Status == -1)Then text_1.text = "Р" ElseIf ((Status & 4096) != 0) Then text_1.text = "?" ElseIf (Status <= 0) Then text_1.text = "-" ElseIf ((Status & 0x3) > 0) && ((Status & 0x3C) == 0) Then text_1.text = "1" ElseIf ((Status & 0xC) > 0) && ((Status & 0x33) == 0) Then text_1.text = "2" ElseIf ((Status & 0x30) > 0) && ((Status & 0xF) == 0) Then text_1.text = "3" 'приоритет мигания ElseIf ((Status & 0x2A) > 0) Then If ((Status & 0x2A) == 2) Then text_1.text = "1" ElseIf ((Status & 0x2A) == 8) Then text_1.text = "2" ElseIf ((Status & 0x2A) == 32) Then text_1.text = "3" Else text_1.text = "-" End If Else text_1.text = "-" End If Else Status = PRJSPEC.TPTS_VL(KKS, Col1, Col2, Col3, AStat) End If If (Status == -1)Then Backgr.fill = Color_Remont ElseIf ((Status & 4096) != 0) || (Status < 0) Then Backgr.fill = Color_Inval ElseIf ((Status & 0x3F) != 0) Then Backgr.fill = "Col_BGmain" Else Backgr.fill = "Col_Grey5" End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: SingleDig.visibility = "hidden" TwoDig.visibility = "hidden" If (KKS != "NULL") Then Z0 = BIN(KKS + "_Z0") OU = BIN(KKS + "_OU") VB6 = BIN(KKS + "_VB6") Else HasErr = True End If If (Z0 != Nothing) Then CatNr = Z0.CategoryNr Else HasErr = True End If If CatNr == 37 Then //это VL HasErr = HasErr || !((VL_type == "1o2") || (VL_type == "1o3") || (VL_type == "2o3") || (VL_type == "1k2") || (VL_type == "1k3")) Else //иначе полагаем, что это IVL HasErr = HasErr || !((VL_type == "1o2") || (VL_type == "1o3") || (VL_type == "2o3") || (VL_type == "1k2") || (VL_type == "1k3") || (VL_type == "2o2") || (VL_type == "3o3")) End If If (HasErr || (Z0 == Nothing)) && IsViewMode Then Backgr.fill = Color_ErLink text_1.text = "О" text_2.text = "/" text_3.text = "П" Else If Left(VL_type, 1) == "1" && OneDigit Then //один знак InGr.width = 30 body.width = 20 Backgr.width = 20 SelFrame.width = 20 LU_edge.points = "5,25 5,5 25,5" RB_edge.points = "5,25 25,25 25,5" text_1.x = 15 text_2.visibility = "hidden" text_3.visibility = "hidden" Shorter = True ElseIf Right(VL_type, 1) == "2" Then //два знака InGr.width = 50 body.width = 40 Backgr.width = 40 SelFrame.width = 40 LU_edge.points = "5,25 5,5 45,5" RB_edge.points = "5,25 45,25 45,5" text_2.x = 32.5 text_3.visibility = "hidden" End If End If
HeightRatio = _This.height / 75.0 text_1.font_size = 16 * HeightRatio text_2.font_size = 16 * HeightRatio text_3.font_size = 16 * HeightRatio
